data.one_liner: Spring Boot-inspired local SQLite CRUD and file helpers for Flutter entities.
data.what_it_does: Automatically generates SQLite CRUD statements from plain Dart entity classes without manual SQL or repository boilerplate. Provides file system helpers for reading, writing, and managing binary files and paths. Supports optional database and file encryption.
use_when: You want local SQLite persistence without writing hand-written SQL or repositories
You need file system helpers alongside local database storage
You want optional encryption for your local database and files
avoid_when: You need a cloud-synced backend database
You require a full ORM with complex relationship mapping
strengths: No hand-written SQL or repository boilerplate required
Handles both local SQLite CRUD and file system storage
Supports cross-platform including mobile, desktop, and web
weaknesses: Requires careful exception handling as most entity methods throw when tables do not exist
First access creates a default database named sqlf_easy.db unless changed
data.setup_notes: Make sure Flutter bindings are initialized with WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() before calling methods that need the application documents directory.
